title: Saturday Expedition: End to End (and back again)
description:
End to End and back again! 

Outward over the peaks and back along lower trails. 

This is a demanding venture and participants need to be regular, long distance trail runners and be able to tackle elevation albeit at a walk. 

There will be pauses for photography and nutrition and recovery! There might even be a pit stop at the MHH jst before the final few kms. 

Bring food and water for the day and expect to be out for 5-5.5 hours. 
Please also carry some basic medical supplies and clothing to appropriate to the day. 

Participants may join for parts of the run but contact Julie to outline your plans and to organise times if necessary.

title: Sprints at Priory
description:
Because sprints are a prior-ity! 😜

This will be a fun running session starting with a quick warmup followed by a 10-20min set of sprints + an easy-pace recovery 3K run + another 10-20min set of sprints + and finished with cool-down stretches to avoid any aches the day after 🔥🔥

Sprints sets: this will be a set of exercises in pairs or teams of 3 (depending on the numbers). One person will be sprinting towards markers (trees/lamposts) and back while their pals will be doing some exercises for active recovery before swapping over.

Sounds intense? Don’t panic, do it at your own pace. This session will be adapted to everyone’s abilities and adapted exercises will be offered when needed.

Meeting point: Priory Park (by the Splash).

Meeting time: 7pm

Duration: ~1hr 

Kit: high-vis clothing and head-torches recommended. I checked the park and is well lit though but bring your torches.
